Text: Next, we plan to build a hydrofication station right next to this! Work will begin immediately after this project is finished, so keep your tools at the handy!
Take everything you need and assemble them on-site! You'll be handling delicate parts with high aetheric conductivity, so take the utmost care with them!
It's time to pave the ground beneath our feet, and in the meantime make a much more comfortable base of operations!
Ugh, is there no end to them!?
And now the fight begins in earnest!
Their leader has finally shown themself.
It would appear the siege has ended.
It can't be... The light divinity!
Hm? I thought I saw flames...
My word, this futile resistance is simply absurd!
I'm no saint, so don't expect restraint!
So very brave─digging your own grave!
This place has seen better days...
Quite a few beasts running amok here.
Let us make for the fortress.
Seems we must fell the beast if we wish to pass.
It's almost as if it's guarding the entrance...
So this is what became of the soldiers...
The corpses are springing to life!?
Let us put him to rest.
The commander of the fortress, it would seem.
Even in death, he continued his command...
We'd best pass through here swiftly!
It may unleash powerful gales. Be on your guard.
Let's give the voidsent what for.
So much coral! So many fish!
It's like a picture scroll brought to life.
Still no sign of any voidsent.
At last, the way to the palace is open.
Please tell me all the wrinkles are gone!
Let her rest here for now.
Let us return peace to the palace.
Does it think itself the master of this place?
The Galeserpent General's counting on us!
Time for a little subtle sorcery.
Let's see them hit me now!
I guess I'm blink tanking again...
If you need to chain skills, just say the word!
I need to time this flare just right!
Starting to get a little tired...
I've still got mana. Let's keep pushing!
Don't you go dying on me!
Thank goodness the generals are unharmed!
Everyone all right? Then let's go eat!
We live to fight another day...
Time to break out the grub!
Their hunger for aether is insatiable...
An amalgamation of beast and machine?
That baleful eye... Be on your guard!
Let's make short work of them!
Doesn't seem like the brightest of foes...
Surprisingly agile for one so rotund!
Not far to the Clyteum now!
I was starting to feel dizzy...
These creatures are made of scrap?
An unseen hand doth guide them...
Something tells me that wasn't designed for people...
This one seems more formidable than the others...
Let's put an end to this!
The eye draweth aether unto itself...
Perhaps it waits for an opportune moment?
We'll make it through this together!
One cannot weather such power alone...
Born of scrap before our very eyes...
If only we could sever those strands...
They command the puppets as one!
By the Twelve! This is madness!
They're beginning to try my patience!
Keep an eye on the minions.
They are a puppeteer of surpassing skill...
I won't fall for that again!
Leave the fodder to us. Don't hold back!
Long hath it been since last we fought together.
How in the hells is it moving so fast?
They're up to something... Be on your guard!
Not quite the lumbering lump I'd expected...
I don't like the looks of this fellow.
